locked_partition_policy: row count read from the split manifest only; no image path, label, score or ID is loaded
vietnam_REPORT_policy: NOT READ in this run. Not used for selection, tuning, thresholds or evaluation.

target_label_semantics.reference_pipeline_target: tb_label == 1, i.e. positives = active_tb + latent_tb + active_latent_tb
target_label_semantics.known_mismatch: latent_tb has tb_label=1 but active_tb_label=0. The frozen baseline trains on tb_label. BOTH encoders in Stage 2 must use this same mapping so the comparison is fair; the mapping is a documented limitation, not something to fix in one arm only.
target_label_semantics.alternative_if_rejected: an active-only target (active_tb + active_latent_tb positive, latent_tb negative) was measured in an earlier run as a prespecified secondary arm and gave +0.0292 on a past-TB subgroup endpoint; it is NOT adopted and must not be mixed into this comparison.

RayDINO (XRay-DINO).input_px: UNKNOWN - read from the model card after access is granted
RayDINO (XRay-DINO).patch_grid: UNKNOWN - depends on input px; 16 does not divide 518

encoder_comparability.consequence: patch grids and embedding dimensions differ, so the cached RAD-DINO tokens CANNOT be reused for RayDINO. Images must be re-encoded. Per the protocol the PRIMARY comparison is matched GLOBAL heads; a regional comparison requires a declared deterministic pooling to a common GxG grid and is secondary.

stage1_score_only_TUNE.classification: EXPLORATORY - TUNE has been used repeatedly in prior experiments and is not independent validation.

negatives_median_score_difference_pastTB.method: 10,000-replicate bootstrap of the difference in medians, seed 20261021

interpretation_limits: past_tb is a CLINICAL HISTORY variable, not a radiologist annotation of fibrosis or scarring. No image-visible finding may be inferred from it.
a score difference by history is an association, not evidence that the classifier uses any particular visual cue.
